backend/main.mo: Defines the main canister with access control, citizen onboarding, user profiles, work logs, DAO proposals, and persistent state maps.
backend/migration.mo: Handles migration from old canister state to new format, copying fields and adding the initialMintCompleted flag.
feature_evidence.json: Placeholder feature evidence report with an empty feature list.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file containing prewritten summaries of all frontend files.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind-based stylesheet defining OKLCH color variables and dark-mode tokens.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML entry point mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React component managing authentication, profile setup gating, theming, and dashboard rendering.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Authentication button handling Internet Identity login/logout states with styled UI.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: Modal prompting new users to submit their name and complete profile setup.
frontend/src/components/contributions/Co: Container with tabs for listing work logs or creating new contribution entries.
frontend/src/components/contributions/Wo: Form for creating work logs with category selection, description, and timestamp inputs.
Displays a sortable list of work logs with verification actions, loading states, and owner-based controls.
frontend/src/components/governance/Gover: Provides a tabbed interface for viewing proposals or creating a new one within the governance module.
frontend/src/components/governance/Propo: Form for submitting new governance proposals with title, description, budget, and timestamp handling.
Fetches and displays proposals with phases, countdowns, vote stats, and loading placeholders.
Application layout component with header, footer, and slot for main content, including login display.
frontend/src/components/profile/UserProf: Shows user profile, citizen onboarding status, and principal info with loading and verification states.
frontend/src/components/wallet/TokenWall: Token wallet UI showing balance and providing a form to transfer SUZHI tokens to another principal.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates a backend actor based on user identity and refreshes dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentUser.ts: Fetches the current caller’s user profile using the active actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication state, login, and identity loading via a React context.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Contains React Query hooks for citizen onboarding, balances, transfers, and work log operations.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles and custom earthy color variables for light and dark themes.
frontend/src/lib/governance.ts: Implements proposal phase calculation and countdown formatting based on start time.
frontend/src/lib/workLog.ts: Maps work log enums to labels and formats work log time spans into readable strings.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Renders the main dashboard with tabs for profile, wallet, contributions, and governance.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides utilities for reading, persisting, and clearing URL and session-stored parameters.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom OKLCH color palette, typography and animation plugins, extended theme settings, and custom keyframes.
project_state.json: Defines the project's state, including dApp summary, architectural notes, features, and configuration for identity, tokens, contributions, DAO, and UI.
